methods.name: Modified TextTiling
methods.description: An unsupervised topic segmentation method that detects topic changes based on a similarity score using BERT embeddings, block-wise max pooling, and cosine similarity between adjacent utterance blocks.

methods.name: BERT embeddings
methods.description: Used to compute representations for every utterance in the meeting transcript.

methods.name: Block-wise max pooling
methods.description: Aggregates utterance embeddings within blocks of utterances to extract block-level embeddings.

methods.name: Cosine similarity
methods.description: Measures semantic similarity between adjacent utterance blocks.

methods.name: Sentence-BERT
methods.description: Pre-trained sentence representation model used to extract fixed size sentence embeddings using a mean over all output vectors.

methods.name: Max pooling
methods.description: Repeatedly applied to extract words with high semantic value and filter out words that hold limited semantic value from a given utterance.

methods.name: topic segmentation model
methods.description: Consists of a sentence representation model to extract semantic similarity between sentences and a segmentation scheme that employs semantic similarity variations over time to detect topic changes.

methods.name: RoBERTa
methods.description: A pre-training configuration of BERT trained with the Masked Language Modelling objective on five large English-language corpora totaling over 160GB of uncompressed text, used to extract fixed features without additional fine-tuning.

methods.name: Feature extraction
methods.description: Extracting a fixed sized vector via max pooling of the second to last layer of a pre-trained model without additional fine-tuning
